_note: Paraphrase set for semantic matching (Nov 16). 10 groups of 3 notes that mean the same thing in different words, and 10 near misses that must not be grouped. Drafted by Claude, not reviewed by a person, and the Spanish and Hindi notes are not reviewed by a native speaker. Synthetic.

notes: Arjun had a meltdown this afternoon. The mall was packed.
Arjun cried and dropped to the floor at the store today, there were too many people.
It was so crowded at the market this afternoon and Arjun had a meltdown.
The fire alarm went off at school this morning and Arjun shut down afterwards.
Arjun went quiet and covered his ears this afternoon, the vacuum was running and it was really noisy.
There was loud drilling next door all morning and Arjun had a meltdown.
Arjun had a meltdown before school. He was up half the night.
Arjun barely slept, and this morning he screamed and cried getting ready.
He tossed and turned until 3 am, then Arjun had a meltdown at breakfast.
Arjun hardly touched his lunch and had a meltdown this afternoon.
He did not eat breakfast, and Arjun melted down later this morning.
Arjun pushed his plate away at noon and ate nothing, then cried all afternoon.
The bus came late and we took a different way to school, Arjun had a meltdown this morning.
There was a substitute teacher today and Arjun melted down in the morning.
We had to do his morning steps in a different order today and Arjun screamed and cried.
We stood in line for ages at the pharmacy this afternoon and Arjun had a meltdown.
The doctor's office kept us sitting there for an hour this morning and Arjun started screaming.
Arjun had to hold on a long time for his turn on the swing this afternoon and he melted down.
Arjun cried getting dressed this morning, the new sweater felt scratchy.
The tag on his shirt was bothering him this morning and Arjun had a meltdown.
Arjun screamed this morning when he put on his socks, the seams felt wrong to him.
I turned the tablet off for dinner tonight and Arjun screamed and cried.
His cartoon time was over this evening and Arjun had a meltdown.
We said no more video games tonight and Arjun melted down.
Arjun tuvo una crisis esta tarde. El centro comercial estaba lleno de gente.
Arjun lloró y se tiró al suelo hoy en la tienda, había demasiada gente.
El mercado estaba abarrotado esta tarde y Arjun tuvo una crisis.
अर्जुन आज सुबह स्कूल से पहले बहुत रोया और चिल्लाया। वह रात भर ठीक से नहीं सोया था।
कल रात अर्जुन की नींद बार-बार टूटी, और आज सुबह वह बहुत परेशान होकर रोने लगा।
Arjun raat ko bilkul nahi soya, aur aaj subah school se pehle bahut roya aur chillaya.

nearMisses.note: The mall was nearly empty and quiet this afternoon when Arjun had a meltdown.
It was very quiet in the library this afternoon when Arjun shut down.
Arjun slept really well last night, but he had a meltdown before school this morning.
nearMisses.why: Sleep is mentioned, and it was good.

nearMisses.note: Arjun ate a big lunch and then had a meltdown this afternoon.
nearMisses.why: A meal is mentioned, and it was eaten.

nearMisses.note: We walked straight in with no wait at the doctor this morning and Arjun melted down in the exam room.
Arjun picked out his favorite soft shirt this morning, then cried when the bus was late.
nearMisses.why: Clothing is mentioned, and it was fine. The bus was the change.

nearMisses.note: Arjun was watching his tablet happily this evening when the doorbell startled him and he screamed.
Everything went exactly as usual this morning and Arjun still had a meltdown before school.
La tienda estaba vacía y tranquila esta tarde cuando Arjun empezó a llorar y tuvo una crisis.
कल रात अर्जुन बहुत अच्छी नींद सोया, फिर भी आज सुबह स्कूल से पहले वह रोने और चिल्लाने लगा।
